name: Forensic Packet Capture
description: Ability to capture, store, and manage network traffic for forensic purposes. Covers full packet capture (PCAP) deployment, capture point selection, storage architecture, legal and privacy considerations for network interception, and ensuring captured data meets evidentiary standards.

0.label: None
0.description: No exposure to forensic packet capture

1.label: Awareness
1.description: Understands the purpose and legal considerations of forensic network capture
evidence: Can explain the difference between forensic packet capture and network monitoring
Understands legal and privacy constraints on network interception
Can describe common capture formats (pcap, pcapng) and their properties

2.label: Guided Practice
2.description: Deploys capture tools and records traffic under supervision with appropriate documentation
evidence: Configured and ran tcpdump or Wireshark captures under guidance
Selected appropriate capture points (TAP, SPAN port, inline) with supervisor approval
Applied capture filters to scope collection appropriately
Documented capture parameters, duration, and hash verification of PCAP files

3.label: Independent Practice
3.description: Independently plans and executes forensic network capture with proper legal authorization and evidence handling
evidence: Independently deployed forensic capture in 3+ investigations with proper authorization
Correctly sized capture infrastructure for throughput and storage requirements
Maintained chain of custody for captured network evidence
Produced capture documentation meeting lab and legal standards

4.label: Advanced / Mentor
4.description: Designs capture architectures for complex environments; handles high-throughput and encrypted traffic challenges
evidence: Designed and deployed capture solutions for high-bandwidth (10+ Gbps) environments
Handled TLS interception requirements with appropriate legal and technical controls
Deployed distributed capture across segmented networks for coordinated collection
Reviews capture plans and mentors junior staff on forensic network collection

5.label: Expert / Authority
5.description: Defines forensic capture methodology; evaluates capture technologies; provides expert guidance on network evidence admissibility
evidence: Authored or maintains the lab's network forensic capture methodology
Evaluated and validated capture technologies for forensic integrity and completeness
Advised legal teams on network evidence admissibility and capture procedures
Trains teams on forensic capture architecture and deployment

assessment_methods.description: Plan and deploy a forensic capture for a simulated investigation scenario, including capture point selection, filter configuration, and evidence documentation
Audit capture documentation and PCAP integrity records from recent network forensics engagements
